JOB_CHECKED_IN.SUBJECT: {garageName}: {registration} checked in
JOB_CHECKED_IN.BODY: Hi {customerName}, your vehicle {registration} has been checked in at {garageName} (job {jobNumber}). Track it here: {link}

PROBLEMS_FOUND.SUBJECT: {garageName}: we found {problemCount} issue(s) on {registration}
PROBLEMS_FOUND.BODY: Hi {customerName}, our inspection of {registration} found: {problemSummary}. See details and photos: {link}

ESTIMATE_SENT.SUBJECT: {garageName}: estimate for {registration} ({currency} {total})
ESTIMATE_SENT.BODY: Hi {customerName}, the repair estimate for {registration} is {currency} {total}. Please review and approve here: {link} (valid until {validUntil})

JOB_APPROVED.SUBJECT: {garageName}: thank you, work on {registration} is confirmed
JOB_APPROVED.BODY: Hi {customerName}, thank you. We have recorded your decision for {registration}; approved amount {currency} {approvedTotal}. Track progress: {link}

READY_FOR_PICKUP.SUBJECT: {garageName}: {registration} is ready for pickup
READY_FOR_PICKUP.BODY: Hi {customerName}, good news: {registration} is ready for pickup at {garageName}. {link}

INVOICE_ISSUED.SUBJECT: {garageName}: invoice {invoiceNumber} for {registration}
INVOICE_ISSUED.BODY: Hi {customerName}, invoice {invoiceNumber} for {registration} is {currency} {total}. Amount due: {currency} {balanceDue}. {link}

SERVICE_REMINDER.SUBJECT: {garageName}: {registration} is due for service on {serviceDate}
SERVICE_REMINDER.BODY: Hi {customerName}, {registration} is due for its next service on {serviceDate}. Call {garagePhone} to book a slot with {garageName}.

STAFF_WELCOME.SUBJECT: Your {garageName} staff account
STAFF_WELCOME.BODY: Hi {staffName}, an account ({role}) has been created for you at {garageName}. Ask your admin for your temporary password; you will be asked to change it on first login.
